output.summary: The win-rate collapse is mostly a mix and measurement effect. From 2026-04-15 the MQL threshold fell to 40 and opportunities began to be created automatically. Low-score (40-59) opportunities, mostly from LeadSpring, now make up 750 of 1,720 closed opportunities and win 3.3%. Many were auto-closed as unresponsive. Excluding that band, the Q3 win rate is 29.4% against 31% in Q1. Rep activity is up, not down. Comp pay is flat and attrition intent is stable. Non-marketing win rate is unchanged, which counts against the Brannock price cut as a cause. Bookings are roughly flat on the same number of won deals. Whether LeadSpring high-score leads are worse than Fieldline's is still unknown. Slower response time is confounded by the quote-requested flag. Re-baseline reporting and stop auto-creating opportunities for 40-59 leads. Do not run PIPs.
